headline: Developer interest for eight city-owned properties, Deputy Director appointment, and sale of LRA alleyway off Chestnut Street.
summary: The meeting covers developer interest in eight city-owned properties under the Lawrence TBD Urban Renewal Plan, a Deputy Director appointment, re-advertising bids for 300 Canal Street Hydro-Unit realtor services, industrial park land, a possible sale of the LRA-owned alleyway off Chestnut Street (Map 128, Parcel 29), and an update on a proposed Micro-Loan Program.
items: Reconfirmation of Developer Interest and Potential Project Modifications for Eight City-Owned Properties Under the Lawrence TBD Urban Renewal Plan (URP)
Re-advertisement of Bids for Realtor Services Regarding 300 Canal Street (Hydro-Unit)

Discussion and Possible Vote on Proposed Purchase and Sale of LRA-Owned Alleyway off Chestnut Street (Map 128, Parcel 29) to Abutting Property Owners, Including Authorization for the Executive Director to Negotiate Terms and Initiate the Disposition Process, if Approved
Update Regarding the Proposed Lawrence Redevelopment Authority Micro-Loan Program
Discussion of the Date and Time of the Next Regular Meeting
plain_text:
LAWRENCE REDEVELOPMENT 
AUTHORITY 
PUBLIC NOTICE OF REGULAR MEETING 
Notice is hereby given that the Lawrence Redevelopment Authority (“LRA”) will hold a Regular 
Meeting as follows: 
Date: Wednesday, October 21, 2026 
Time: 5:00 p.m. 
Location: 255 Essex Street, Lawrence, Massachusetts 01840 
This meeting is being held in accordance with the Massachusetts Open Meeting Law, M.G.L. c. 
30A, §§ 18–25. 
AGENDA 
1. Call to Order 
2. Roll Call and Determination of Quorum 
3. Approval of Minutes 
4. Executive Director’s Report 
5. General Counsel’s Report 
6. New Business 
A. Reconfirmation of Developer Interest and Potential Project Modifications – Eight City-
Owned Properties Under the Lawrence TBD Urban Renewal Plan (URP) 
B. Appointment of Deputy Director. 
C. Re-advertisement of Bids for Realtor Services Regarding 300 Canal Street (Hydro-Unit). 
D. Discussion Regarding Industrial Park Land. 
E. Discussion and Possible Vote Regarding the Proposed Purchase and Sale of the LRA-Owned 
Alleyway Located off Chestnut Street (Map 128, Parcel 29) to Abutting Property Owners,
Including Authorization for the Executive Director to Negotiate Terms and Initiate the 
Disposition Process, if Approved. 
F. Update Regarding the Proposed Lawrence Redevelopment Authority Micro-Loan Program. 
7. Executive Session (If Necessary) 
8. Next Meeting 
Discussion of the Date and Time of the Next Regular Meeting. 
9. Adjournment 
Posted by Order of the Lawrence Redevelopment Authority. 
Octavien A. Spanner 
Executive Director/Secretary 
Date Posted: _______________________ 
Time Posted: _______________________
